title: Microsoft Purview DLP: set policy tips and email notifications separately for SharePoint and OneDrive rules (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The roadmap facts, notification behaviour, licensing and PowerShell control are supported. Minor corrections would complete the portal route, cite editing permissions and remove checklist instructions for controls missing from the table.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table and prose
claims.claim: The printed Microsoft Purview portal creation route reaches User Notifications in a SharePoint and OneDrive DLP rule.
claims.quote: Select Custom from both the Categories list and the Regulations list. On the Define policy settings page, the Create or customize advanced DLP rules option should already be selected. Set the User Notifications toggle to On.
claims.fix: Use this fuller route in controls[0].ui and the rendered table: 'Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Enterprise applications & devices > Categories: Custom > Regulations: Custom > Assign admin units > Choose where to apply the policy > SharePoint sites > OneDrive accounts > Define policy settings > Create or customize advanced DLP rules > Customize advanced DLP rules > + Create rule > User Notifications'. The omitted scope selections and already-selected advanced-rules option do not invalidate the printed route. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-create-policy-spo-odb-external.

claims.claim: Set-DlpComplianceRule -Identity <rule name or GUID> -NotifyUserType Email,PolicyTip modifies a rule's notification type to both.
claims.quote: The Identity parameter specifies the DLP rule that you want to modify. The NotifyUserType parameter specifies the type of notification that's used for the rule. Valid values are: NotSet; Email; PolicyTip; Email,PolicyTip.

claims.claim: Notification type is configured per DLP rule.
claims.quote: The NotifyUserType parameter specifies the type of notification that's used for the rule.

claims.claim: Set-DlpComplianceRule is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

claims.claim: Learn lists NotSet, Email, PolicyTip and Email,PolicyTip as valid NotifyUserType values.
claims.quote: The NotifyUserType parameter specifies the type of notification that's used for the rule. Valid values are: NotSet; Email; PolicyTip; Email,PolicyTip.

claims.claim: The SharePoint and OneDrive creation walkthrough uses the combined policy-tip notification option before choosing who is notified.
claims.quote: Select Notify users in Office 365 services with a policy tip and then select Notify the user who sent, shared, or last modified the content.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Learn walkthrough does not describe cloud-specific decoupled portal labels or four separate choices.
claims.quote: Searched: "DLP" "decoupling" "GCC" existing rules rollout policy tips. Read dlp-create-policy-spo-odb-external in full and notifications/policy reference; the walkthrough gives the combined policy-tip option and no cloud-specific decoupled labels.

claims.claim: The cited SharePoint and OneDrive walkthrough describes creation, not editing an existing rule.
claims.quote: Searched: edit and existing rule in the complete dlp-create-policy-spo-odb-external walkthrough. Its procedures are Steps to create policy and Steps to create the variant policy, not an existing-rule editing route.

claims.claim: A DLP rule can send people email notifications.
claims.quote: When you create a DLP policy, you can configure the user notifications to: Send an email notification to the people you choose that describes the issue.

claims.claim: A DLP rule can display a policy tip for content conflicting with the policy.
claims.quote: Display a policy tip for content that conflicts with the DLP policy

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Policy tips on SharePoint and OneDrive documents show a warning icon when the rule sends a notification.
claims.quote: When a document on a OneDrive site or SharePoint site matches a rule in a DLP policy that uses policy tips, special icons appear on the document: If the rule sends a notification about the file, the warning icon appears.

claims.claim: A blocked icon appears on SharePoint and OneDrive documents when a matching rule using policy tips blocks access.
claims.quote: When a document on a OneDrive site or SharePoint site matches a rule in a DLP policy that uses policy tips, special icons appear on the document: If the rule blocks access to the document, the blocked icon appears.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: The DLP policy reference says user overrides are enabled only when Notify users in Office 365 services with a policy tip is enabled.
claims.quote: User overrides are enabled only when Notify users in Office 365 services with a policy tip is enabled, so user overrides go hand-in-hand with Notifications and Policy tips.

claims.claim: For SharePoint and Exchange, overrides are configured in the user notification section.
claims.quote: For Exchange online and SharePoint in Microsoft 365, you configure overrides in the user notification section.

claims.claim: Notification emails are sent unprotected.
claims.quote: Notification emails are sent unprotected.

claims.claim: A custom notification email body can contain the %%MatchedConditions%% token for SharePoint and OneDrive.
claims.quote: You can also use the following tokens to help customize the body of the email. | %%MatchedConditions%% | The conditions that the content matched. Use this token to inform people of possible issues with the content. | Yes | Yes | Yes |

claims.claim: Only new content triggers an email notification.
claims.quote: Only new content triggers an email notification.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Editing existing content triggers policy tips but not email notifications.
claims.quote: Editing existing content triggers policy tips, but not email notifications.

claims.claim: Email notifications can be sent only to individuals, not groups or distribution lists.
claims.quote: You can send email notifications only to individual recipients, not to groups or distribution lists.

claims.claim: Notification recipients can include a specific user, the content owner, last modifier or site owner.
claims.quote: These people can include the owner of the content, the person who last modified the content, the owner of the site where the content is stored, or a specific user.
